items.text: Figure 18.6 Pressure in liquids acts equally in all directions.A can of water with holes can be used to demonstrate this.

items.text: One of thefirst demonstrationsof the effects of airpressurewascarried out byOttovan Guerickein 1654,inMagdeburg.Germany.VanGuerickehad two large metal bowls made,put them togetherand thenpumped the air out.The bowls could not bepulled apart,even when he attached two teams of horses tothebowls.
